prompt: if i deposit $500/month at 5% APR for 10 years, whats the future value
text:
Using the future value of an annuity formula:

$$FV = PMT \times \frac{(1 + r)^n - 1}{r}$$

Where:
- PMT = $500 (monthly deposit)
- r = 0.05/12 ≈ 0.004167 (monthly rate)
- n = 120 (months in 10 years)

$$FV = 500 \times \frac{(1.004167)^{120} - 1}{0.004167}$$

$$FV = 500 \times \frac{1.6453 - 1}{0.004167}$$

$$FV = 500 \times 154.60 \approx \$77,303$$

**Your future value is approximately $77,303** after 10 years of $500 monthly deposits at 5% APR.

This includes about $60,000 in deposits (500 × 120) and roughly $17,303 in accumulated interest.
